nodes.description: A patent (US9514753B2) describing methods, systems, and apparatus for performing speaker identification using hash-based indexing of speaker vectors.

A vector derived from an utterance, used as a query for comparing against speaker vectors.<SEP>A vector derived from an utterance, used as the query representation for identifying a speaker. It may be an i-vector or a vector of parameters based on deep neural network activations.
Values determined for an utterance vector according to multiple different hash functions, used to look up speaker vectors in hash tables.

Multiple different functions used to compute hash values for vectors; may include locality sensitive hash functions or functions based on the position of a vector with respect to different hyperplanes.
Vectors each derived from one or more utterances of a respective speaker, stored in hash tables and compared against an utterance vector to identify a speaker.
A plurality of tables storing speaker vectors indexed by hash values, from which a set of speaker vectors is determined using the hash values of an utterance vector.
A person whose speech characteristics are represented by speaker vectors and whose identity is determined by selecting a matching speaker vector.

The identity of a speaker determined based on associations between speaker vectors and respective speakers, corresponding to a selected speaker vector.<SEP>The identity of a speaker determined from the selected speaker vector and output as data.
An utterance vector comprising parameters determined using multivariate factor analysis of the utterance.
A speaker vector comprising parameters determined using multivariate factor analysis of one or more utterances of a respective speaker.
A neural network whose activations, occurring in response to information about an utterance, are used to determine parameters of utterance vectors and speaker vectors.
Media items that include utterances of a speaker corresponding to the selected speaker vector, which can be identified and output.
A process of authenticating a particular user based at least in part on determining that the selected speaker vector corresponds to that particular user.
A type of hash function used to determine hash values for vectors.
Geometric constructs with respect to which the position of an utterance vector is used to determine hash values.
Scores each indicating a degree of similarity between the utterance vector and one of the speaker vectors in the set, used to select the most similar speaker vector.
A measure of distance between the utterance vector and each speaker vector in the set, used as a similarity score.
A threshold value against which the smallest cosine distance is compared to decide whether to select the corresponding speaker vector.
A set of multiple video resources accessed to generate a speaker vector for each resource.
A vector derived from one or more utterances of a respective speaker, used to characterize the speech of that speaker.
A table among a plurality of hash tables from which a set of speaker vectors is determined using hash values.
A value determined for an utterance vector according to a hash function, used to look up speaker vectors in hash tables.
A function used to determine hash values for an utterance vector, with multiple different hash functions being applied.
A technique used to determine parameters of utterance i-vectors and speaker i-vectors.
A video resource from a set of multiple video resources, for which a speaker vector is generated.
A device storing instructions that, when executed by one or more computers, cause the computers to perform operations for speaker identification.
A computer that executes instructions stored on a computer-readable storage device to perform operations.
A system comprising one or more computers and a computer-readable storage device storing instructions for performing speaker identification operations.

A network service that enables developers to develop recommenders made available to content site operators for providing recommendations to end users, and that optimizes the use and selection of recommenders for different end users, groups, segments, content sites, and the like.

A site that requests event data storage and item recommendations from the personalization network service over a computer network.<SEP>A site that requests item recommendations from the recommendations system over a computer network via a network service interface, and that may provide recommender selections and weighting selections.

A component developed by developers that generates item recommendations; may be external recommenders operated by entities different from the personalization network service provider.<SEP>A component or service provided by a recommender provider that uses collected event data regarding user-generated events to select particular items to recommend to users; recommenders are registered with the recommendations system and accessed via network addresses.

A recommender registered with the recommendations service and provided by one or more entities that differ from the provider of the recommendations service, operated by different operators than the personalization network service operator.<SEP>A recommender external to the system, associated with a plurality of external recommenders, whose provider may provide machine readable descriptions of it.

An entity that operates and provides recommenders, separate from the operator of the personalization network service.<SEP>An entity, different from the provider of the recommendations system, that provides recommenders and submits registration submissions to request registration of the recommenders with the recommendations system.
A user to whom recommendations are provided by content sites through the personalization network service.

An interface operative to receive a first request from a content site to store event data and a second request from the content site for item recommendations, both received over a computer network.<SEP>An interface over a computer network through which requests from content sites for item recommendations are received.
A repository comprising physical computer storage operative to store event data received from the content site.

A module configured to provide functionality for registering an external recommender with a recommendations service.<SEP>A module configured to allow a provider of an external recommender to provide machine readable descriptions of the external recommender.
An interface operative to provide access to the event data to a plurality of external recommenders registered with the recommendations service.

A service comprising a recommendations retriever that queries external recommenders for recommendations, receives recommendations and associated scores, and selects a subset of recommendations to provide to the content site.
A component operative to, in response to a request, query a plurality of external recommenders over the computer network for recommendations and receive recommendations and associated scores.
A module configured to normalize associated scores, optimize recommendations based on user-generated events and previous requests, and assign weights to external recommenders.
Data descriptive of user-generated events comprising identifiers of particular items and particular users to which the events correspond.

Events generated by users, including purchase events, item viewing events, and item rating events, that may be responsive to recommendations.<SEP>Events generated by users, comprising one or more of purchase events, item viewing events, and item rating events, used by recommenders to select items to recommend.
Item recommendations generated by recommenders, at least some based at least in part on stored event data, and associated with scores.
Scores associated with recommendations received from recommenders, which may be normalized and combined with weights to produce overall scores.

Weights applied to recommenders, which may be site-specific, user-specific, user segment-specific, or default, and are adjusted based on user-generated events.<SEP>Weights applied to each of the recommenders, which may be based on recommender performance and may be selected by content sites, and which are combined with normalized scores to generate overall scores.

Scores produced by combining scores with weights, used to select a subset of recommendations to provide to the content site.<SEP>Scores generated by combining normalized scores with weights, used in selecting recommendations to provide to content sites.

A system comprising computer hardware programmed to implement the network service interface, event data repository, registration module, data interface, recommendations service, and optimization module.<SEP>A system comprising computer hardware that performs the computer-implemented method of providing a network service to content sites; may comprise multiple physical computing devices.
A network over which requests, recommendations, and scores are transmitted between the content site, personalization network service, and external recommenders.

Submissions received from recommender providers operative to request registration of recommenders.<SEP>Submissions from recommender providers operative to request registration of the recommenders with the recommendations system.

A computer-implemented system that registers recommenders from external recommender providers, stores access information for the recommenders, receives requests from content sites for item recommendations, causes the recommenders to provide recommendations, normalizes scores, applies weights, and combines scores to generate overall recommendations.
A type of user-generated event involving a user purchasing an item.
A type of user-generated event involving a user viewing an item.
A type of user-generated event involving a user rating an item.
Scores produced by normalizing the scores provided by the recommenders.
Information stored in computer storage for accessing the recommenders with the recommendations system, comprising uniform resource indicators.
The form of access information used for accessing the recommenders with the recommendations system.
A repository that stores information regarding a plurality of recommenders, including network addresses for accessing the recommenders on a network.

A system comprising computer hardware operative to provide a service through which content sites obtain recommendations from a plurality of recommenders, responsive to requests by using network addresses to request recommendations and combining resulting recommendation sets.
Addresses for accessing the recommenders on a network, stored in the computer data repository.
A combined set of recommendations generated by combining recommendation sets returned by the recommenders, to be provided to the content site.
Performance of each recommender in each of a plurality of contexts, monitored by the server system and used to determine how much weight to give to particular recommenders in each context.
A type of context-specific performance relating to a specific user.
A type of context-specific performance relating to a specific segment.
A type of context-specific performance relating to a specific site.
Descriptions of an external recommender provided by its provider in machine readable form.
Storage in which access information for accessing the recommenders with the recommendations system is stored.
An operator of a content site who obtains item recommendations for presentation to users and who may specify which recommenders are to be used via an interface.
Users to whom item recommendations are presented.
Selections of recommenders received from content sites.
Selections of weights received from content sites.

edges.description: The patent describes obtaining an utterance vector derived from an utterance as part of speaker identification.
The patent describes determining hash values for the utterance vector according to multiple different hash functions.
The patent describes determining and comparing speaker vectors to select a speaker vector.
The patent describes determining a set of speaker vectors from a plurality of hash tables using hash values.
The patent describes determining a speaker identity corresponding to the selected speaker vector and outputting data indicating the speaker identity.
Hash values are determined for the utterance vector.
The speaker vectors in the set are compared with the utterance vector to select a speaker vector.

A speaker identity is determined corresponding to the selected speaker vector.
